name: supportdesk-platform
description: Minimal, professional customer support ticketing platform with keyword classifier and SLA worker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "classifier,server,worker,client" -c "magenta,blue,yellow,cyan" "npm run dev:classifier" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix worker install && npm --prefix client install
